text: As the Dakar Rally began its second Saudi edition on 2 Jan 2021, human rights organisations continued to accuse Saudi Arabia of sportswashing - using sport to divert attention from human-rights issues - while organisers defended the kingdom as host under its Vision 2030 openness push.

source.name: France 24 (AFP) - Dakar Rally set for second Saudi outing despite 'sportswashing' row
